method: Manual source-visible coarse exposed-rock footprint tracing on actual1024 RGB, coordinates expressed in native128 reference. No RGB hue classifier, new source, height inference or procedural detail.
uncertainty: Draft contours have up to about1-2 native-pixel local uncertainty; ambiguous snow caps, dark cast shadows and coarse contacts require independent review before recipe. Not qualified as a faithful whole-image mask.
